reason: Go requires a network rule's host to be one of the provider's own declared domains or aliases (server/internal/app/detection.go validateDetection: the network loop checks slices.Contains(p.Domains,n.Host) || slices.Contains(p.Aliases,n.Host)), so a provider can never declare a network rule pointing at a host it never qualified. The Rust validator did not enforce this containment at all; since fixed (endpoint/src/detection.rs validate()) to require the same containment.
